evals.prompt: Core Company OS onboarding is done and Hermes is running on this VPS. Connect my Notion comments as @kamdarai; the root is https://notion.so/Tasks-725195b678ee475099946dfaedf086c0.
evals.expected_output: Begins with the bundled preflight and keeps the route ngrok-only without proposing Hermes installation or a reverse proxy.
assertions: Assumes Hermes is already installed
Uses ngrok as the only public ingress
Does not inspect or change Caddy, Nginx, Traefik, DNS, or VPS users
Does not ask for technical input beyond the supplied root and chosen mention
Makes preflight the next action before configuration

evals.prompt: Preflight says NGROK_AUTHTOKEN is missing. The open-login receipt says browser_opened=false and links https://dashboard.ngrok.com/get-started/your-authtoken. My root is https://notion.so/Tasks-725195b678ee475099946dfaedf086c0. Continue setup.
evals.expected_output: Routes authentication through the browser opener, provides a clickable fallback on a headless host, and never asks for credentials in chat.
assertions: Names open-login as the ngrok or Notion authentication route
Falls back to the returned clickable URL when no GUI browser is available
Names secure-set as the credential-entry route
Does not request a token in chat
Continues from the structured phase receipt after authentication

evals.prompt: Do I need to enable comment replies before I give you the Notion root page?
evals.expected_output: Explains that replies are intrinsic to this connector and does not present a reply-enable choice.
assertions: Does not ask whether replies should be enabled
Treats Notion comment replies as always enabled
Keeps page-property writes separate and disabled by default
Does not add a NOTION_ENABLE_COMMENT_REPLIES decision gate
Continues onboarding without waiting for this preference

evals.prompt: The Notion subscription is verified. Are we done?
evals.expected_output: Rejects premature completion, routes next through table discovery and one trigger comment, and requires workspace lockdown plus a persisted reply receipt.
assertions: Names data-source discovery as the immediate post-verification phase
Requests exactly one harmless test comment using the configured mention
Names finalize as the workspace-lock and reply-proof phase
Requires reply_observed=true before readiness
Does not equate tunnel or process health with end-to-end success
